scope: Independent read-only source review and Node tests. The sole written artifact is this report; no browser or model generation was performed.

geometry_audit.independent_engine: Shapely union, validity, equality and symmetric_difference
geometry_audit.coverage_fixture: Target component bounds plus the loaded Bund18 confirmed boundary and its reserved owner; browser coverage is checked separately.

reviewed_invariants: Actual source IDs are grouped with numeric/string aliases; unsafe numeric IDs and unknown geometry are retained conservatively.
Only complete MultiPolygon components are replaced. Single crossing polygons and ambiguous nonidentical overlapping fragments remain in the original source.
Residual geometry retains original coordinates, holes and source height properties; no footprint clipping or invented union is emitted.
Original aggregate state is hidden only after scoped residual content, source readiness and a subsequent rendered frame.
Original states are restored before replacing or clearing residual data; failed restoration prevents residual replacement.
New original-source fragments restore masks immediately and invalidate in-flight snapshots by source epoch.
Coverage changes require visible loaded owner cells and loaded reserved landmarks; stale transactions cannot reapply old masks.
Residual source/layer identity, source ownership and visibility are guarded during updates and after readiness.
The residual GeoJSON has a separate source ID; its own data events do not call original-source sourceChanged, avoiding a self-triggered update loop.
Standalone destruction preserves residual cover if original restoration failed; map-scene explicitly uses immediate map removal to finish teardown.

resolved_findings.finding: Pending residual updates did not initially guard against missing or replaced residual layers.
resolved_findings.resolution: Source/layer identity and visibility guards now reject readiness; destruction removes only resources still owned by this helper.

resolved_findings.finding: A layer could become missing or hidden after successful readiness while cached original masks remained applied.
resolved_findings.resolution: Persistent guards invalidate readiness once, synchronously restore original masks through residualInvalidated, and recheck readiness before the same-signature fast path can hide originals again.

resolved_findings.finding: The 6,000 ms residual readiness deadline repeatedly rejected valid but very slowly rendered fallback updates.

evidence.last_error: OSM residual render readiness timed out.

resolved_findings.resolution: Default and invalid-option fallback deadlines increased from 6,000 ms to 30,000 ms. Source-content, source-loaded and subsequent-render requirements remain unchanged; original geometry stays visible while waiting.

verification.post_change_browser_confirmation: Separate parent-task browser run in progress; this static report does not claim that run passed.

limits: No browser was opened by this reviewer. The parent supplied the failed 6-second forced-outage run as evidence; post-change forced-outage validation is a separate parent-task publication check.
Continuous changes to original source fragments deliberately keep original buildings visible until a stable residual snapshot is ready.
Conservative retention can leave an overlap for unsupported crossing or ambiguous components; it avoids removing unrepresented source footprints.
